powers: You may discard a card to add 1d6 (☐+1) and the Fire trait to a combat check by a character at your location; if the discarded card has the Alchemical (☐ or Attack or Poison) trait, add an additional 1d6.
When you banish a card that has the Alchemical trait for its power, you may draw a random card of the same type that has the Alchemical trait from the box and recharge it.

roles.name: Tinderfoot
powers: WYou may discard a card to add 1d6 (☐+1) and the Fire trait to a combat check by a character at your location; if the discarded card has the Alchemical (☐ or Attack or Poison) trait, add an additional 1d6 (☐ 2d6).

When you banish a card that has the Alchemical trait for its power, you may draw a random card of the same type that has the Alchemical trait from the box and (☐ put it on top of your deck or) recharge it. (☐ You may instead draw 2; return 1 of them to the box.) (☐ You may instead draw 3; return 2 of them to the box.)
While you play or would banish a spell that has the Fire trait, gain the skill Arcane equal to your Craft skill.
☐ Gain the skill Divine equal to your Craft skill; when you attempt a Divine check, you must first either recharge a blessing or discard the top card of your deck.

☐ At the start of your turn, if you have fewer cards in hand than the number of cards that have the Fire (☐ or Alchemical) trait in your discard pile, you may recharge a random card that has the Fire trait from your discard pile.

roles.name: Firesolver
powers: You may discard a card to add 1d6 (☐+1) (☐+2) and the Fire trait to a combat check by a character at your location; if the discarded card has the Alchemical (☐ or Attack or Poison) trait, add an additional 1d6 (☐ and the card’s adventure deck number).
When you banish a card that has the Alchemical trait for its power, you may draw a random card of the same type that has the Alchemical trait from the box and recharge it.
While you play or would banish a spell that has the Fire trait, gain the skill Arcane equal to your Craft skill.

☐ When you play a card that has the Fire trait on your combat check, you may display it next to your location. Add 1d6 (☐ 2d6) and the Fire trait to combat checks by characters at that location. At the start of your turn, bury that card.
☐ Add the number of cards that have the Fire trait in your discard pile to your check that invokes the Fire trait. (☐ If you add at least 1, ignore a bane’s immunity to Fire for that check.)
